annotations.title: Join up to 3 clips into one video

description: Joins 1–3 clips into one video to post, in order. Each clip is a ready 'own' upload (source_id) or one of your ready videos (video_id), cut to start/end seconds (each at least 0.5 s, 10 minutes in all); overlap: seconds of crossfade into the previous clip (0–2). request_id: a new unique string per video; the same request_id returns the same video, never a second one. Poll get_video until ready.

overlap.description: Seconds of crossfade from the previous clip (not on the first)

video_id.description: Or one of your ready videos (list_videos)

request_id.description: A new unique id per stitched video; repeat it only to retry the same request

name: stitch_videos
title: Join up to 3 clips into one video
